identity: A board where shapes or files are dragged into boxes, folders, or a framed area to satisfy a placement goal.

scenarios.name: single
scenarios.screen: One shape sits outside one unlabeled box on the board. The box is empty.
never: A shape already fully inside the box

arrangements.text: The box and shape occupy separate areas of the board.
A wide box sits on one side of the board, with a large shape opposite it at the same height.
A wide box sits above the shape.
The shape sits to the left of the box.

scenarios.hint: Put the one target colored shape outside an empty rectangular container large enough to contain it fully. Preserve the exact requested color and shape.

scenarios.name: collect
scenarios.screen: About six shapes and one unlabeled box appear on the board. In a collection task the shapes start outside the box; in a removal task they start inside it.
never: A color label on the box
A shape palette for creating copies

arrangements.text: The shapes are scattered around the box.
One large box sits in the middle, with shapes in tidy columns on both sides.
The box sits above tidy rows of shapes.
Two unlabeled boxes sit side by side, with the shapes in rows below them.

scenarios.hint: Show several target-colored shapes and several other-colored distractors outside one large empty rectangular bin.

scenarios.name: sort
scenarios.screen: Several shapes sit outside two or three boxes. The boxes carry category labels, except when two boxes are identified by position.

arrangements.text: The boxes occupy separate areas of the board, with shapes scattered outside them.
Wide boxes sit side by side above tidy rows of shapes.
The boxes stack vertically, with the shapes in a tidy block beside them.
Three boxes form two columns, with two above one; the shapes sit in rows below.

scenarios.hint: Show exactly the requested named color categories as separate large labeled rectangular bins; all shapes start outside bins and their fill matches a bin label.

scenarios.name: desk
scenarios.screen: About five file icons sit on a desktop with folder icons and a Trash target. The folder window is closed, and the files remain visible on the desktop.
never: A file list visible inside a folder
Shape boxes or a shape palette

arrangements.text: Folder icons and Trash occupy their desktop positions, with file icons spread across the remaining desktop area.
Folder icons and Trash stay in place while the file icons occupy different free positions across the desktop.

scenarios.name: palette
scenarios.screen: A palette holds shape templates beside a canvas containing a frame. The canvas has no placed copies, so the frame is empty.
never: A copy already placed in the frame

arrangements.text: Shape templates occupy the palette area beside the canvas, and the frame sits within the canvas.
The palette and canvas keep their positions, with a different selection of templates occupying the palette slots.
